name: Eimear

facts.text: Eimear: level 50, model 705 (a body used elsewhere only by one Outland garda), faction Krrzck, aggro 99, at about 366,900/262,600 by the mantid town of Krrzck in World's End; Zuraspa (46) of the same faction stands near her; respawn 320 seconds; a plain spawn with no script.
Krrzck is the mantid settlement of World's End (quests: 'Corruptors, Botonids, and Trade' raises standing with the mantids of Krrzck; 'The Sylvan's Pain' sends the player to Xcrzrk 'outside Krrzck').
Living Server lore: Eimear as the one Sylvan the mantids of Krrzck took in, who speaks for them.

story:
The mantids are not friendly and not enemies; they are busy. The Sylvan have said it of them for as long as there have been Sylvan, and the mantids of Krrzck, the settlement on the high ground of World's End, have never given them reason to say anything else. They trade when trade is useful, through a single go-between at a time, and they keep their town shut. In all the generations of the isle exactly one outsider has been let inside, and she is still there. Her name is Eimear.

She was an outlander girl of Altan Garran, the gorge folk say, who walked out of the town at fifteen after a quarrel with her family and walked west along the coast until she reached the edge of the world, and sat down outside the mantids' wall, and did not leave. They let her in after a season. Nobody knows why. The Domnann wardens think the mantids wanted someone who could speak to the Sylvan in their own tongue; the outlanders think the mantids simply admired her stubbornness, which is the one quality the mantids are known to admire. Eimear has lived among them since, and wears their colours, and is counted by them as one of the town.

She speaks for Krrzck now, when it speaks. The Sylvan of Necht who trade with the mantids deal with her, and say that she has become more mantid than they would like: patient, cold, very exact about prices, and quick to strike at anyone who comes too close to the town without having earned the right. A traveller of good standing with the mantids, who has hunted the corrupt Sylvan and the bark-strippers that trouble them, she lets pass. Anyone else she treats as the mantids treat a stranger. Zuraspa, a mantid of the town, is never far from her.

The mantids have one fear, and Eimear has taken it on with the rest: she will not say the name of the hunter of Allta Fearann aloud, and the Sylvan who have heard her refuse say she has gone pale doing it.
legend: Eimear (50) stands by the mantid town of Krrzck in World's End, faction Krrzck, with Zuraspa (46) nearby. Her aggro level is 99 rather than the usual 200, so standing with the Krrzck faction matters: raising mantid faction (the 'Corruptors, Botonids, and Trade' quest talks of killing treecutters and barkstrippers for them) is the polite way past her. As a fight she is a plain level 50 with no script, a quick kill for a 50 group, with a 320-second respawn. Killing her will not help your mantid standing, and mantid faction is useful in World's End: the mantids trade, and their town is a safe spot if they like you.
